response.sql:
WITH patient_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(HGB / HCT) as avg_ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio
  FROM patient_ratios
),
first_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    pr.ID,
    pr.avg_ratio,
    oa.overall_avg_ratio,
    pr.avg_ratio - oa.overall_avg_ratio as above_overall
  FROM patient_ratios pr
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE pr.avg_ratio > oa.overall_avg_ratio
),
second_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as second_avg_ratio
  FROM first_filter
),
second_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    ff.ID,
    ff.avg_ratio,
    ff.overall_avg_ratio,
    ff.above_overall,
    sa.second_avg_ratio,
    ff.avg_ratio - sa.second_avg_ratio as above_second
  FROM first_filter ff
  CROSS JOIN second_avg sa
  WHERE ff.avg_ratio > sa.second_avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(above_overall) as avg_above_overall,
  AVG(above_second) as avg_above_second
FROM second_filter;

assumptions.assumption: Tests where HCT is 0 or null are excluded from ratio computation, as stated in the request that tests where the ratio cannot be computed should be ignored.
